from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/jaanam-ya-husain.md')
before = p.read_bytes()
front, body = before.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
metadata, roman = front.decode().split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
changes = {
    'hameiṅ parwaaz do': 'hameiṅ parwaaz parwaaz do',
    'Hum azadaroṅ': 'Hum azaadaaroṅ',
    'apna azakhana': 'apna azaakhaana',
    'farsh-e-azadari': 'farsh-e-azaadaari',
    'Baadshah': 'Baadshaah',
    'baadshah': 'baadshaah',
    'ahl-e-aza': 'ahl-e-azaa',
    'shaal-e-aza': 'shaal-e-azaa',
    'ye aza ye sada': 'ye azaa ye sada',
    'bas gaya': 'bas gaya',
    'Shah-e-Karbobala': 'Shah-e-Karb o Bala',
    'rahe Karbobala': 'rahe Karb o Bala',
    'la ilaah saj gayi': 'la ilaah bach gayi',
    'Shah-e-Karbala': 'Shaah-e-Karbala',
}
for old, new in changes.items():
    assert old in roman, old
    roman = roman.replace(old, new)
source_lines = body.decode().splitlines()
roman_lines = [line.strip() for line in roman.split('\\n')]
assert len(source_lines) == len(roman_lines)
digits = str.maketrans('۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹', '123456789')
for source_line, roman_line in zip(source_lines, roman_lines):
    assert bool(source_line) == bool(roman_line)
    if source_line.isdecimal():
        assert source_line.translate(digits) == roman_line
    assert all(c.isascii() or c in 'ṅṄ' for c in roman_line)
    assert source_line.count('حسین') == roman_line.count('Husain')
assert roman.count('parwaaz parwaaz do') == body.decode().count('پرواز پرواز دو')
output = (metadata + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + roman).encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + body
p.write_bytes(output)
assert p.read_bytes().split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == body
print(sum(bool(line) and not line.isdecimal() for line in source_lines), 'verse lines in each version')

    'la ilaah saj gayi': 'la ilaah bach gayi',
    'Shah-e-Karbala': 'Shaah-e-Karbala',
}
for old, new in changes.items():
    assert old in roman, old
    roman = roman.replace(old, new)
source_lines = body.decode().splitlines()
roman_lines = [line.strip() for line in roman.split('\\n')]
assert len(source_lines) == len(roman_lines)
digits = str.maketrans('۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹', '123456789')
for source_line, roman_line in zip(source_lines, roman_lines):
    assert bool(source_line) == bool(roman_line)
    if source_line.isdecimal():
        assert source_line.translate(digits) == roman_line
    assert all(c.isascii() or c in 'ṅṄ' for c in roman_line)
    assert source_line.count('حسین') == roman_line.count('Husain')
assert roman.count('parwaaz parwaaz do') == body.decode().count('پرواز پرواز دو')
p.write_bytes((metadata + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + roman).encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + body)
assert p.read_bytes().split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == body
print(sum(bool(line) and not line.isdecimal() for line in source_lines), 'verse lines in each version')
